---
name: Language proposal
about: Discuss syntax or semantics before implementation
title: "[Proposal] "
---

## Rule being proposed

State the rule precisely with a small example.

## Why it belongs in Ostrin

Explain the problem it solves and how it fits meaningful types, safe software,
reproducibility or general-purpose use.

## Alternatives and costs

Consider syntax, checker behavior, interpreter/native parity, ownership,
concurrency and tooling impact.

## Test matrix

List accepted programs, rejected programs and any backend or target differences.
